reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes that minor Pt addition to equiatomic FeCoNi will form an L10 phase; L10 ordering requires near-equiatomic Pt (e.g., FePt, CoPt) and is not expected at <10 at.% Pt in a high-entropy matrix, making the mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with explicit XRD/TEM and magnetic measurements, and a well-defined falsification criterion based on coercivity increase and L10 phase confirmation.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamentally flawed premise about L10 ordering in this composition range, and prior work already showed FeCoNiPt is soft ferromagnetic, so it does not advance the question.
